subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(17,13,68)

(55, 46, 495)

(NOTE : Operation should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding / deleting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
solution:
Lets see the number of sets given:

(17,13,68)

now considering the first number given in the pair as the reference to other numbers,

17 - 13 = 4

17 × 4 = 68

thus first you have to subtract the number with the middle number and multiply the obtained number with the first number which will result into the third number of the given pair
